language.title: Commit message language
language.description: Any language name, for example English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese or 繁體中文; it is passed to the model as written. 'auto' or blank follows the IDE interface language. Chinese and English stay shortcuts for their long names.

maxDiffChars.title: Maximum diff characters
maxDiffChars.description: The prompt budget after the IDE's own 1 MiB pending-commit limit.

commitTypes.title: Allowed commit types
commitTypes.description: Title is the value the model must return; description explains when to pick it and is included in the prompt. Older string-only lists are still accepted.

default.title: style
default.description: Formatting or style, no behaviour change

default.title: refactor
default.description: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature

editorShowType.title: Show the type field
editorShowType.description: Editor: whether the manual structured editor shows these fields. The subject is always shown.

editorTypeStyle.title: Type option order
editorTypeStyle.description: table keeps the order of the allowed types above; common-first puts the first rows first and sorts the rest. The host form draws a dropdown, so a radio list is not available.

editorCommonTypes.title: Common types shown first
editorCommonTypes.description: Only used with the common-first order: how many rows of the allowed types stay on top.

skipCiPresets.title: Skip CI markers
skipCiPresets.description: The markers the editor offers. Name is how a project picks the default; Marker is what the message gets.

skipCiDefault.title: Default Skip CI marker
skipCiDefault.description: Name of a marker above, or the marker itself. Blank uses the first marker.

skipCiDefaultChecked.title: Skip CI checked by default
skipCiDefaultChecked.description: Whether the editor starts with the marker ticked.

actionGenerate.title: Show the Generate button
actionGenerate.description: The four buttons above the commit message. A hidden button is removed from the toolbar; the command stays available in Find Action.

actionGenerateWithContext.title: Show the Generate with Requirements button

actionManual.title: Show the Edit Fields button
actionManual.description: Opens a list of the commit fields; each field is edited in its own dialog.
